TO: | PROSPECTIVE PROPOSERS
FROM: Sam Rivera
ADDENDUM No. 1:
The contents of this addendum alter and amend the original bid requirements and take precedence over the related items therein.
This addendum forms a part of the contract documents. Proposers must acknowledge receipt of all addenda when submitting their
proposals. Failure to acknowledge receipt may render your proposal non-responsive and ineligible for award.
All addenda will be posted on the Empire State Purchasing Group: www.empirestatebidsystem.com
**PLEASE NOTE THE FOLLOWING: IMPORTANT INFORMATION: All Bidders shall note:
Please note these questions and their answers:
1. Frequency band: Should the Motorola XPR 3500e (Item 1) and Motorola R5 (Item 2) be UHF or VHF?
UHF Frequency
2. Configuration: Is a display and keypad model required for either item, or a non-display model?
Mini Keypad Model
3. Programming: Should the radios be programmed to the City's existing channels before delivery? If so, will
the City provide the programming file?
No Programming Required
4. Accessories: Should each radio include a battery, charger, antenna, and belt clip?
Battery, Charger, Antenna and Belt Clip should be included.
5. Refurbished units: For Item 1, what minimum warranty does the City expect on used or refurbished
radios?
There is not hard and fast rule, but something pragmatic for a school district w/ daily usage.
6. Award: Our reading is that the City wants 100 units of Item 1, or 50 units of Item 2 if Item 1 cannot be
supplied, not both. Should we price both lines on the form?
The preference of the District is to order the most of Line #1 that we can, but if that option isn’t feasible,
we will look to buy Line 2 at a lesser quantity.
No further changes at this time.
**END OF BID ADDENDUM NO. 1**
RFQ-2027-91587: ADDENDUM No. 1 – ACKNOWLEDGEMENT – Return this document with your sealed bid.
